comment: Reviewed false positives of tools/check-emulator-terms.py (C-SEP-TERMS): words that also occur in vendor/emulator/ but carry no emulator internals where they are used. Listed by the SHA-256 prefix the check prints, with a reason that doesn't name the word. Added only by pull request.

reviewed.reason: A column name in the header of fwtest's own ipb.csv output (docs/HARNESS.md, 'Outputs'), chosen by the harness: the instruction count of the second core. It is fwtest's interface, not a name taken from the emulator.
A public part-family name of the LCD controller, sourced in the hardware spec from FM-1-RE's display document and the manufacturer's datasheet, not from the emulator.
The common name of a public 16-bit pixel format, quoted in the hardware spec from FM-1-RE's display document.
A plain port-pin name (port A, pin number), the usual way to name a pin of the SDK's JL_PORTA; the pin's role in the spec is cited to experiment E-7.
The start address of main RAM, a hardware fact the firmware takes from docs/HARDWARE-SPEC.md (HW-6, sourced to the JieLi SDK and FM-1-RE) for its linker script, its beacon and its tests.
The address of the debug message register, a hardware fact from docs/HARDWARE-SPEC.md (HW-25, sourced to the JieLi SDK's csfr.h), cited in the firmware's design notes.
The load address and entry of the raw image, from docs/HARDWARE-SPEC.md (HW-1) and docs/HARNESS.md ('The raw image'), used in the firmware's linker script.

The largest raw image's length (1 MiB less 16 KiB) written in hex, from docs/HARDWARE-SPEC.md (HW-5) and docs/HARNESS.md ('The raw image'), used as the image region's length in the firmware's linker script.
